title: Spinning Text (Magic UI)
notes:
The Spinning Text component animates text in a circular motion with customizable speed, direction, color, and transitions for dynamic and engaging effects.

Install into a project: npx shadcn@latest add @magicui/spinning-text

npm dependencies: motion

Original file: https://github.com/magicuidesign/magicui/blob/main/apps/www/registry/magicui/spinning-text.tsx
